about_short_description.short_description: Trinkerr is a Social Trading Platform.

product.name: Live Trading
product.description: A service that allows users to deploy algorithmic trading strategies in real-time markets at specified entry times to automate trading actions.

product.name: Forward Testing
product.description: A feature that tracks the live profit and loss of trading strategies before real money deployment, simulating live trading conditions.

product.name: Pre-built Algos
product.description: A collection of ready-to-use algorithmic trading strategies including equity-based, Greek-based option selling, and indicator-based option buying strategies.

product.name: Trinkerr Learning Universe
product.description: An educational service offering live sessions and real-time strategy simulations to help users understand and master algorithmic trading.

product.name: Exclusive Community
product.description: A community platform, primarily via Telegram, where users receive daily updates on top-performing trading strategies and engage with other traders.
